---
title: "Candidate ensemble specification"
---

`cand_ensemble` follows `app/cards/template.py`: mutable and pipeline-compatible,
callable export, settled model/style options and enablement, background evaluation,
current-argument export readiness, configuration restoration and code recording.

`ensemble.representatives` reads zero-based weighted winners from current
`tuning_results.review.representatives`. Read-only or missing evidence is rejected.
Each member is a complete unfitted evaluated pipeline. Models default to all
available methods; restored valid exclusions persist. The preferred metric is a
display setting and does not trigger fitting or affect representative selection.

`evaluate_ensemble` uses `pipeline_search.prepare` for the first selected member
to reuse plan validation, implicit resampling and weighting exclusions. Each
member is cloned and fitted once within each split. Member predictions and their
combination are scored on the same validation rows using task-specific scorers.
All supported metrics are collected once. Mean/median regression and aligned
probability/majority classification use equal member weights. Stacking is deferred.

`EnsembleEvaluation` retains the unfitted definition, per-split fitted ensembles,
split memberships and metric scores. These potentially large runtime objects are
shared across proxy clones, treated as read-only and regenerated on restoration.
`proxy_data.ensemble_results` validates source data, roles, modelling context,
evaluation plan and active pipeline. `with_ensemble` rejects stale evaluations and
sets the active pipeline to one ensemble terminal step: complete member pipelines
must not be wrapped in duplicated upstream preprocessing. No full-data fit occurs.

Footer Apply/Ensemble controls downstream export. Disabled export is the unchanged
incoming proxy; enabled export waits for matching evaluation. No partially fitted
ensemble is exported. Background cancellation is cooperative between member fits;
a native fit already running must finish before its thread exits. Runtime fitting
errors must remain visible, not become successful empty results.

The front horizontal bars show selected members plus ensemble, best first by
signed scorer, losses displayed naturally. Orange distinguishes ensemble. Flip
side shows every feasible task metric mean, sorted by the preferred metric, with
preferred-metric fold SD and split count. Unavailable metrics are missing, not zero.
Repeated/grouped/temporal plans preserve the upstream memberships; post-selection
resampling is explicitly distinguished from independent test performance.

Tests cover five representatives, member subsets, median/mean combination,
training-only scalers, classification voting and weights, upstream plan reuse,
unfitted downstream definition, current runtime evidence, invalidation,
cancellation, sorted metrics, checkbox export and browser restoration.

Evaluation identity includes data, roles, modelling context, resampling plan,
seed, task, selected member trial IDs and complete pipelines, and ensemble style.
Progress publications, unrelated trials, changes to unselected winners and review
weights that leave the selected winners unchanged do not cancel or reject an
in-flight evaluation. Result and export readiness use the same identity; task
arguments retain the original matching snapshot until fitting inputs change.
